spec_basis.STU-LAY-035: A table is a structured object flowed inside a `StudioTextStory`; its cell content is text, graphics or nested tables.
spec_basis.STU-LAY-139: break_headers, break_footers: header_break.in_all_text_columns, header_break.once_per_text_frame, header_break.once_per_page; skip_first_header, skip_last_footer; stroke_order row_on_top / column_on_top / best_joins / legacy_compatibility; row_type row.body / row.header / row.footer
spec_basis.STU-LAY-140: Every tint in the table model carries a DECLARED hard range of 0..100 `percent`
spec_basis.STU-LAY-141: row_span, column_span; minimum_height, maximum_height (the row-height at-least/exactly behaviour is expressed as this pair); keep_with_next_row; start_row (start this row on the next frame, page, odd page or even page); The four edge-stroke PRIORITY fields are the mechanism by which two adjacent cells with different edge strokes resolve which one draws
spec_basis.STU-LAY-028: Picture frames of arbitrary shape (rectangle, ellipse or any `StudioVectorPath`) MUST clip and fit placed content.
spec_basis.STU-LAY-029/131: Fitting MUST support fit-content-to-frame, fit-frame-to-content, fit-content-proportionally, fill-frame-proportionally, centre-content and clear-fitting, plus a stored frame content-fit rule and an anchor point for placed content; Studio MUST expose ONE fitting enumeration that is their union
spec_basis.STU-LAY-014/108: Sections MUST partition a document for numbering; section_prefix limit FIVE characters; prefix MUST NOT contain `,` or `+`; two sections MUST NOT share a prefix; two sections MUST NOT start on the same page; page_number_start hard 1 .. 999999
spec_basis.STU-LAY-015: Automatic page-number markers MUST resolve to the current page's section number wherever placed (parent page, running header, TOC).
spec_basis.STU-LAY-044/148: Tables of contents MUST be style-driven; the same paragraph style MUST NOT be mapped twice within one TOC style; a TOC style MUST carry at least one entry
spec_basis.STU-LAY-045/149: Indexing MUST build a topic/subtopic hierarchy through inserted index marks, with sort-by overrides; exactly FOUR topic levels
spec_basis.STU-LAY-046/150: Notes MUST include footnotes, endnotes and sidenotes; footnote_start_at 1..400; footnote_restart_numbering dont_restart / page / spread / section
